svg.title: An authorized sprint reaches a PR
svg.desc: Current assistive source flow with retained historical citations. The user's request authorizes the agreed work; ordinary drafts, task progress and in-scope methods require no second artifact approval, context ticket or receipt-driven reviewer chain. Actual user stops, host/security controls and commit/publication permissions remain. This source explanation is not a captured live host run. Actual endpoint: A checked report and open PR. Sprint never infers merge; an earlier same-scope grant can authorize a ready PR. Discard needs named-branch confirmation. Conditions and return paths remain in the companion reading view.

Manrope Variable, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Agree the outcome → implement within scope → report and hand off

svg.title: Establish the working agreement
svg.desc: command: /ca:sprint: select the work → skill: brainstorming: sprint definition → skill: writing-plans: linked draft → skill: /ca:sprint: maintain the agreement. A maintained spec and plan for the authorized outcome. Material unresolved product choices go to the actual owner; ordinary planning does not wait for an artifact approval receipt.

path.title: define scope: The selected new sprint enters the definition phase.
draft pair: Derive useful tasks and checks from the current agreed specification.
agreed scope: Keep the linked plan aligned with the authorized outcome; no artifact approval ceremony is required.

g.title: /ca:sprint: select the work. Resolve an existing exact-format pair before starting new work. This map follows a new HTML pair; existing Markdown retains its own contract.

text.font-family: JetBrains Mono Variable, Consolas, Cascadia Mono, monospace
Manrope Variable, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif

g.title: brainstorming: sprint definition. Capture the outcome, exclusions, priorities and real constraints. Read relevant recorded intent and existing decisions; ask only consequential unresolved owner questions.

text.font-family: JetBrains Mono Variable, Consolas, Cascadia Mono, monospace
Manrope Variable, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif

g.title: writing-plans: linked draft. Maintain a same-format spec/plan pair with useful criteria, tasks, dependencies and checks. A draft_preview binding identifies current source; ordinary in-scope plan maintenance needs no separate artifact permission.

text.font-family: JetBrains Mono Variable, Consolas, Cascadia Mono, monospace
Manrope Variable, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif

g.title: /ca:sprint: maintain the agreement. Continue under the user's existing authorization with the maintained spec and plan. Do not arm pair approval or delegate-methods for ordinary work. Explicit requested checkpoints and material outcome changes still belong to their actual owner.

svg.text: Continue ↓ Build and verify each task

svg.title: Build and verify each task
svg.desc: skill: subagent-driven-development: select → skill: Task engine: implement or delegate → skill: tdd inside authoring → skill: Task engine: verify truthfully. Useful implementation and actual check results. Reported progress remains separate from independent review, passing verification and release readiness.

path.title: useful unit: Implement directly or delegate when useful within actual host permissions.
behavioral task: Use the verification approach appropriate to the change; documentation or non-runnable work uses concrete relevant validation.
actual results: Record checks actually run and inspect the result against the agreed criteria.

g.title: subagent-driven-development: select. Read compact task-context or exact symbols and inspect the full dependency ancestry. Unresolved ancestors remain visible with their IDs and reasons; independent work can proceed. Inspect existing IN_PROGRESS work before redispatch and preserve independently blocked tasks.

text.font-family: JetBrains Mono Variable, Consolas, Cascadia Mono, monospace
Manrope Variable, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif

g.title: Task engine: implement or delegate. Work directly for a focused change or delegate a coherent unit when useful. Supply relevant criteria, paths, constraints and checks within actual host permissions. Bounded context delivery ends after two attempts with an advisory unknown observation; missing critical inputs and actual conflicts still stop dependent work.

text.font-family: JetBrains Mono Variable, Consolas, Cascadia Mono, monospace
Manrope Variable, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif

g.title: tdd inside authoring. Select proportional verification: genuine regression RED/GREEN for fixes, criterion-focused checks for features, and passing characterization baselines for refactors. Preserve behavioral assertions, meaningful negative controls where needed, coverage and lint.

text.font-family: JetBrains Mono Variable, Consolas, Cascadia Mono, monospace
Manrope Variable, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif

g.title: Task engine: verify truthfully. Compare work with the agreed criteria and run relevant checks through the host-governed tool. Record actual command outcomes and limitations with task-check; caller-reported results do not certify an independent review or passing named-test proof.

svg.title: Assess risks and report progress
svg.desc: agent: Combined quality reviewers → agent: finding-triage → skill: Task engine: honest implementation progress. Relevant findings, actual check outcomes and honest implementation state. A failing or unrun check remains visible; an actual user stop remains blocked.

path.title: classify: The active caller retains responsibility for severity and scope.
honest progress: Record actual implementation progress without claiming that pending verification passed.

g.title: Combined quality reviewers. Review the relevant diff when risk or change size warrants it. Select specialist review for actual security, dependency or migration concerns or an applicable policy; a receipt change alone does not require another reviewer.

g.title: finding-triage. Classify actual findings and preserve out-of-scope follow-ups. Correct affected work and revisit only conclusions changed by relevant source, requirements or evidence.

g.title: Task engine: honest implementation progress. Use receipt-free task-review and accept-scope to record implementation readiness or DONE with a real reason. These labels do not certify tests, independent review or release. Preserve blocked members, real user stops and outstanding checks.

path.title: current commit: The normal completion path reaches finalization.
reuse procedure: Run the existing procedure without invoking its entry again.
review before PR: Only the actual reviewer results support the final verdict.

g.title: commit-gate. When a commit is authorized, retain staged-diff inspection, secrets checks and applicable tests through commit-gate. Artifact progress does not create commit, merge or publication authority.

Manrope Variable, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif

g.title: finishing-a-development-branch. Sprint defaults to Open a PR. An earlier same-scope merge grant selects Merge via PR after exact-head checks and review. Discard still needs named-branch confirmation.

g.title: /ca:pr procedure reused in place. The finisher executes the PR procedure here; the command is not re-invoked. Existing caller ownership prevents a routing loop.
